english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 5(2) of the Explosives Regulations 2014 and section 33(1)(c) of, and Schedule 3A to, the Health and Safety at Work Act 1974.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
Keep explosives
without a valid explosives certificate certifying that person to be a fit person to keep explosives, or
keeps more explosives than the quantity referred to in the explosives certificate, or
where the explosives certificate specifies the description of explosives which that person is a fit person to keep, keeps only explosives of that description; and fails to keep them at a place specified in the explosives certificate

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time Limit for prosecutions:
NoneNote
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
